log_pybullet_commands: start logging all pybullet simulation commands to a binary file using startStateLogging
replay_pybullet_commands: replay previously logged pybullet simulation commands from a binary file using startStateLogging with STATE_REPLAY_ALL_COMMANDS
load_urdf_models: load URDF robot and scene models into the pybullet simulation using loadURDF
stop_state_logging: stop the active state logging session using stopStateLogging with the log ID
reset_simulation: reset the pybullet simulation to its initial state using resetSimulation
